title: Alkenyl-type ligands functionalized tin-lanthanide oxo nanoclusters as molecular lithography resists

material_class.structural_family: Sn–Ln oxo nanocluster assembled from {Sn2Eu2} tetranuclear units

synthesis.procedure: Chlorotriphenyltin (145.0 mg, 0.4 mmol), Eu(NO3)3·6H2O (111.0 mg, 0.3 mmol), 5-norbornene-2,3-dicarboxylic acid (80.0 mg, 0.2 mmol), glycolic acid (45.0 mg, 0.6 mmol), DMF (4 mL) and deionized water (0.5 mL) were mixed and sealed in a 20 mL vial, then transferred to a preheated oven at 80 °C for 7 days. After cooling to room temperature, colorless crystals of Sn6Eu4 were obtained.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal synthesis in a sealed 20 mL vial in a preheated oven
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled to room temperature; colorless crystals isolated

properties.summary: UV–vis diffuse reflectance of Sn6Eu4 was recorded; no magnetic data were reported. Crystal color is colorless.

measurements.name: UV–vis diffuse reflectance spectrum
measurements.conditions: solid-state optical diffuse reflectance; BaSO4 reference (SI)

material_class.structural_family: inter-cluster docking Sn–Ln oxo nanocluster of two {Sn6Eu4} moieties / 8 {Sn2Eu2} units

synthesis.procedure: Butyltin hydroxide oxide (104.0 mg, 0.5 mmol), Eu(NO3)3·6H2O (111.0 mg, 0.3 mmol), 5-norbornene-2,3-dicarboxylic acid (45.0 mg, 0.2 mmol), glycolic acid (45.0 mg, 0.6 mmol), DMF (4 mL) and deionized water (0.5 mL) were mixed and sealed in a 20 mL vial, then transferred to a preheated oven at 100 °C for 4 days. After cooling to room temperature, colorless crystals of Sn12Eu8 were obtained.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal synthesis in a sealed 20 mL vial in a preheated oven
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled to room temperature; colorless crystals isolated

properties.summary: UV–vis diffuse reflectance of Sn12Eu8 was recorded; no magnetic data were reported. Crystal color is colorless.

material_class.structural_family: triangular-pyramid Sn–Ln oxo nanocluster from {Sn4Er3} and {Sn3Er} subunits

synthesis.procedure: Butyltin hydroxide oxide (104.0 mg, 0.5 mmol), Er(NO3)3·5H2O (111.0 mg, 0.25 mmol), 5-norbornene-2,3-dicarboxylic acid (80.0 mg, 0.2 mmol), NaCl (10 mg, 0.2 mmol), DMF (4 mL) and deionized water (0.5 mL) were mixed and sealed in a 20 mL vial, then transferred to a preheated oven at 60 °C for 4 days. After cooling to room temperature, pink crystals of Sn13Er6 were obtained.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal synthesis in a sealed 20 mL vial in a preheated oven
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled to room temperature; pink crystals isolated

properties.summary: UV–vis diffuse reflectance of Sn13Er6 was recorded. The cluster is solution-stable in DMF by ESI-MS; lithography performance was studied but is not a magnetic property. Crystal color is pink. No magnetic data were reported.

measurements.name: UV–vis diffuse reflectance spectrum
measurements.conditions: solid-state optical diffuse reflectance; BaSO4 reference (SI)
